summary: Iteration 36: Verified the Admin console sidebar redesign (desktop + mobile) and smoke-tested the new email wiring. 16/16 backend pytest checks pass (login+httpOnly cookie, register->welcome email, assistant lead->enquiry ack, 11 admin/data endpoints, brute-force lockout). Frontend: all 11 sidebar items render as a VERTICAL sidebar on desktop (single x=413, 11 distinct y), no page or sidebar horizontal overflow (docScroll==docClient==1920, navScroll==navClient==238). All 11 tabs switch content, highlight active (bg-[#1C221F]) and update ?tab=. Deep-link /admin?tab=settings opens Settings with the Email/SMTP card and highlights the nav item. Mobile 390px: same nav collapses to a single-row horizontally scrollable strip (navScroll 1397 > client 350) with NO page overflow (docScroll 390). Regression: Retreats pane shows retreat-photo-upload, Overview shows dashboard stats, Import/Gift Cards/Broadcast/Courses/Students/Classes/Bundles panes all render. Zero console errors.

minor.issue: allow_origins defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=False. Login sets an httpOnly cookie which will therefore never be sent on any cross-origin request; per auth playbook prefer explicit origins + allow_credentials=True (works today only because FE/BE share the ingress origin and auth uses Bearer tokens).
ADMIN_PASSWORD falls back to a hardcoded default ('TonyYoga2026!'); should come from env only. seed_admin correctly updates the existing admin hash (idempotent) and hash format is $2b$12$ — OK.

issues: Scrollbar is hidden (no-scrollbar) and the strip is clipped mid-item with no fade/affordance, so it is not obvious more tabs exist to the right. Consider an edge fade or partial-peek indicator.
No issues: sidebar sticky, adequate contrast (dark #1C221F active pill on #FAFAF7 text), consistent 46px item spacing, content pane aligned with header max-w-6xl.

action_items: Optional: add scroll affordance (edge fade) to the mobile admin nav strip.
Optional hardening: set explicit CORS_ORIGINS + allow_credentials=True if the httpOnly cookie is meant to be used, else drop the cookie.
Optional: remove hardcoded ADMIN_PASSWORD fallback in seed.py.
Housekeeping: a leftover manual test user 'test / test@g.com' exists in Students (not created by this run).
critical_code_review_comments: Admin.jsx is 1943 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Each pane (StatsPane, CoursesPane, SettingsPane, ImportPane, RetreatsPane, GiftCardsPane...) should be extracted into src/pages/admin/*.jsx; the new ADMIN_NAV/AdminNavItem makes this split straightforward.

Sidebar layout is sound: `flex md:flex-col` + `overflow-x-auto` on the same node gives correct mobile/desktop behaviour with no residual page overflow; validTabs list is duplicated conceptually with ADMIN_NAV — derive validTabs from ADMIN_NAV.map(i => i.key) to avoid drift.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 throwaway registered users (tonyyoga.qa+welcome*@gmail.com) and 4 ai_leads (TEST_QA) during smoke tests — ALL DELETED from MongoDB after the run (users: 2 deleted, ai_leads: 4 deleted).
test_credentials: tony@tonyyoga.com / TonyYoga2026! (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md) — valid, login returns admin role + httpOnly cookie
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin sidebar redesign verified good on 1920px and 390px. Note DELETE /api/admin/students/{id} and /api/admin/users/{id} do not exist (404) — user cleanup must be done directly via motor/MongoDB. Correct admin endpoints: /api/admin/stats, /api/admin/stats/trend, /api/admin/dashboard, /api/admin/users, /api/admin/students/progress, /api/admin/instructor-applications, /api/class-instances, /api/programs, /api/admin/settings, /api/admin/gift-cards, /api/bundles (there is no /api/admin/students, /api/admin/classes, /api/admin/applications, /api/courses, /api/retreats). Emails DO actually send via live Gmail SMTP — always use plus-addressed throwaway addresses.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects reproduced. Email wiring confirmed by backend log lines '[EMAIL sent] ... Welcome to Tony Yoga' and '[EMAIL sent] ... Thanks for your enquiry' matching the addresses generated by this test run.
